title: The Empty Parish
author: Sebastian Delacroix
blurb: Sable Sandoval, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
